scripts.dev: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process');if(!fs.existsSync('client/dist/index.html'))cp.execSync('npm run build:client',{stdio:'inherit'})" && npm run dev:server
scripts.test: npm run test:client && npm run test:server
scripts.lint: npm --prefix client run lint && npm --prefix server run lint
scripts.deploy: npm run build:client && npm run build:server && cd server && sam deploy
